privacy.title: Inqubomgomo Yobumfihlo
privacy.s1Body: I-Great Sport Bets iqoqa ulwazi oluncane lomuntu siqu oludingekayo ekudaleni i-akhawunti nokufinyelela ku-Premium, kufaka phakathi amakheli e-imeyili nemininingwane yokukhokha ecutshungulwa ngokuphephile nge-Stripe (iwebhu) ne-Google Play / RevenueCat (Android).
privacy.s2Body: Sisebenzisa ulwazi lwakho ukunikeza ukufinyelela kumathiphu ethu okubheja, ukucubungula izinkokhelo, nokuphatha uhlelo lokudlulisela. Asidayisi idatha yakho yomuntu siqu kwabanye.
privacy.s3Body: Sisebenzisa izindlela zokuphepha ezisezingeni lembonini nge-Supabase, Stripe, Google Play ne-RevenueCat ukuvikela idatha yakho. Nokho, akukho ndlela yokudlulisa nge-inthanethi ephephile ngo-100%.
privacy.s4Body: Uma unomibuzo ngalolu Mthetho Wokugcina, ngicela ubusisebenzini kithi ku greatsportbets@gmail.com.

terms.title: Izimiso Zokusebenza
terms.s1Body: Great Sport Bets inikeza izimpendulo zokugcina zokugcina kanye nezinto ezibekwa ngobuqiniseko. Asingasinikezi izinsiza zokugcina noma izobuciko. Zonke izinto zokugcina zenzeka ngesikhathi sakho.
terms.s2Body: Ukufinyelela kwePremium kuqinisekiswa ngemikhiqizo yokugcina ku-Android (Google Play, kuqondiswa ngu RevenueCat) kanye nezindlezo ezizenzeka e-web (kuqondiswa nguStripe). Izinkokhelo ze-Google Play zibhekwa emthethweni wezingqubo zokukhokha nezipho ze-Google Play. Izindlezo ze-web ziyaphuma uma ukufinyelela kuqinisekiswa.
terms.s3Body: Uhlelo lwethu lokugcina abanye lukhulekise ukusebenzisa kwakho kuphela. Ukusebenzisa okubalulekile, okubandakanya ukuzigcina ngokwethu noma ukwakheka kwekhonto olungabonakali, kuzokuthola ukukhangisa khonto nokulahlekelwa kwezinsiza.
terms.s4Body: Great Sport Bets ayigcinwa ukuthi uzoyithola imali. Izibonakaliso zedlule azibonisi iziphetho ezizayo. Zihambisana njalo ngokugcina ngokuzinikeza.

deletion.title: Ukulahlekelwa Kwakhonto Nokugcina Imininingwane
deletion.intro: KuGreat Sport Bets, siyahlonishwa ukugcina kwakho futhi sinikeza indlela ecacile yokulahlekelwa khonto lakho kanye nemininingwane yakho.
deletion.warningBody: Ukulahlekelwa kwakhonto lakho kuyaphuma. Uzokulahlekelwa ukufinyelela kwePremium kwakho, izinsiza zokugcina abanye, kanye nezombuso. Lokhu kwenzeka akukwenzeki ukukhetha.
deletion.step1: Thumela i-email ku <email>{{email}}</email> kusuka ekheli le-email elihlobene nokkhonto lakho kuGreat Sport Bets.
deletion.step2: Yenza isihloko sika-email sibe yiyo "Account Deletion Request".
deletion.step3: Icelswa yakho izobhalwa ngaphakathi kwezingayisiki ezine izinyanga. Uzokuthola i-email yokukhombisa ukuthi ukulahlekelwa kuseyenzeke.
deletion.deleted2: Izinkokhelo zokufinyelela kwePremium kanye nezombuso zokukhokha
deletion.deleted3: Izixhumanisi zokugcina abanye, izikodi, kanye nezombuso
deletion.keptBody: Ukuze kuqondiswe emthethweni kanye nezindleko (isib. ukubhalwa kwezinothi zozemali kuStripe kanye nezinkokhelo ze-Google Play), singathinta izinombolo zezinkokhelo kanye nemininingwane yezinto zokufinyelela kuze kube yizinyanga ezine. Lezi zinto zingenzi ngesikhathi sakho esibonakalayo futhi zisebenzisa kuphela ukuhlola.
